name: unique_last
expr: [c, ia, ic] = unique(v, 'last'); [cc, iac] = unique([1+1i 2 1+1i 3], 'last'); [cr, iar] = unique(R, 'rows', 'last'); ia1=double(ia(1)); ia2=double(ia(2)); ia3=double(ia(3)); icend=double(ic(end)); iac3=double(iac(3)); iar1=double(iar(1));
comment: Sig: [C,ia,ic]=unique(A,'last'). ia selects the LAST occurrence (sorted setOrder): vec [3 1 2 1 3] -> ia=[4 3 5]; complex [1+1i 2 1+1i 3] -> ia(3)=4; rows -> ia(1)=3. Fixes bugs/builtin/unique-last.md (sorted order). 'stable'+'last' ordering deferred.
